extracted.name: Grilled Pineapple Salsa
extracted.description: Spiced up with jalapeno pepper, cilantro, and lime juice, this fruity salsa is a refreshing topper for chicken, fish, or pork.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 fresh pineapple - peeled, cored, and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Coat pineapple slices with cooking spray.
Cook pineapple on the preheated grill until lightly browned and caramelized, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer pineapple to a cutting board to cool, then chop.
Combine pineapple, bell pepper, onion, cilantro, jalapeño, lime juice, garlic, sugar, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl. Refrigerate until chilled and flavors blend, about 1 hour.
